reason: After reviewing the Dolby Laboratories 10-K filing for fiscal year ended September 26, 2025, no total addressable market (TAM) figures were disclosed by the company itself. The filing contains descriptions of the company's business segments, licensing models, product offerings (Dolby Atmos, Dolby Vision, audio codecs), and revenue composition, but does not include any specific TAM estimates, market size figures, or addressable market valuations published by the company in this filing or referenced from company-disclosed investor materials.
